title: The Beatles win Trustees Award at the Grammy Awards | 1972
content:
The Beatles won a Trustees Award at the 14th Annual Grammy Awards on 14 March 1972.

None of The Beatles attended the ceremony, which was held at the Felt Forum at Madison Square Garden in New York City. John Lennon had been scheduled to appear, but pulled out due to his 16 March immigration hearing requiring some last-minute preparation.

Andy Williams presented the award, as well as a preview of the forthcoming film The Concert For Bangladesh.
